overview_description.description:
Today influence marketing is in its early stages. Influencers who create professional content, and are being contacted by sponsors, have few mechanisms to showcase their influence and reach in a professional way.


With themidgame, influencers can build a professional looking profile by connecting their social media and website accounts. themidgame gathers metrics and creates a trustworthy and beautiful-looking public profile that influencers can share with potential sponsors.
